release_summary: A playtest that adds Cherry's Quests 1.0.0 (/cq), a quest tracker with font, outline, size, scale, width, background, sort and progress-bar options. Ctrl+click a quest to cycle through the NPCs its texts name and put the one picked in the game's NPC tracking list, the list the world map's NPC search fills; the pick is remembered per character and quest. It replaces the game's and pbInfo's trackers while shown and redraws only after quest events, with a fallback check every 10 seconds. Hub 0.4.21 lists it. Everything from the 0.11.85 playtest is included unchanged.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: Cherry's Quests adds 15 regressions covering drawing and sorting, row stacking, Ctrl+click order (links, bracketed ids, exact name search, turn-in NPC) and wrap-around, remembered picks across Reload UI, fixed tracking slots and the SetTarget fallback, folding, event-delayed redraws, no quest reads or allocation on idle frames, no double wrapping after Reload UI, fonts and the hub off switch. The NPC tracking calls, the format of quest texts, font restoring, text heights and hiding the other trackers have not been seen in the real client; the in-game checks are in docs/TESTING.md. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and byte-identical files.
